label: explicit_exclusion
rationale: The exclusion list explicitly names desmoplastic small round cell tumor among excluded pediatric-type sarcomas. Broad STS wording does not override this exclusion.
cohort_reconciliation: The two randomized radiotherapy/surgical-timing arms and concurrent observational cohort share a study restricted to primary resectable extremity/trunk-wall STS. No separate DSRCT exception is stated.
extra_biomarker_requirement: No molecular gate establishes a DSRCT exception.
protocol_uncertainty: External protocol is unreviewed; the saved record is NOT_YET_RECRUITING. Anatomic, recurrence and risk restrictions also apply, but the disease-name exclusion is sufficient for this source-scope judgment.
quotes: Soft tissue sarcomas (STS) originating at different sites (i.e., retroperitoneal, abdominal, pelvic, head and neck), gynecological sarcomas, as well as gastrointestinal stromal tumors (GISTs), desmoid-type fibromatosis and pediatric-type sarcomas (i.e., extraosseous Ewing sarcoma, embryonal/alveolar rhabdomyosarcoma, desmoplastic small round cell tumor) are excluded.

label: insufficient_evidence
rationale: The record permits histologically confirmed Ewing sarcoma and conditionally Ewing-like sarcoma treated under the protocol's Ewing paradigm. It does not explicitly identify DSRCT or EWSR1-WT1. The condition-field EWSR1-non-ETS category does not establish that this diagnosis satisfies the protocol-dependent Ewing-like classification.
cohort_reconciliation: Radiotherapy and surgical cohorts differ by tumor size and local-control strategy; none supplies a broader DSRCT-specific disease entry route. The common eligibility criterion remains controlling.
extra_biomarker_requirement: The listed EWSR1-non-ETS condition is not a sufficient molecular inclusion rule for DSRCT; protocol-defined histology/treatment-paradigm membership is unresolved. A tumor panel is requested for tumors at least 8 cm, without a stated DSRCT-compatible result threshold.
protocol_uncertainty: The external definition of Ewing-like and its treatment-paradigm criteria is unavailable in the reviewed modules. Retain uncertainty instead of converting a shared gene/category or absent name into inclusion or explicit exclusion.
quotes: Histological confirmation of Ewing sarcoma, including both skeletal and extra-skeletal primary tumors. Patients with "Ewing-like" sarcoma may be eligible if patients are planned to be treated per Ewing treatment paradigms, as defined in this clinical trial
Round Cell Sarcoma With EWSR1-non-ETS Fusion

label: explicit_diagnosis_compatible
rationale: DSRCT is explicitly listed among high-risk extracranial solid tumors. The relapsed/refractory and transplant-context restrictions remain separate from disease-name compatibility.
cohort_reconciliation: One stem-cell graft/zoledronic-acid regimen proceeds through phase Ib dose finding and phase II. No separate histologic restriction removes DSRCT. However, patients with progressive solid tumor disease after relapsed/refractory treatment are excluded, so the broad relapsed/refractory inclusion is not unconditional.
extra_biomarker_requirement: No tumor molecular inclusion gate is stated for DSRCT. An eligible haplo-identical related donor is required and is not established by diagnosis.
protocol_uncertainty: Ages 6 months through 25, prior autologous-transplant failure/ineligibility or stated low chance of cure, donor availability, disease control and other clinical criteria require individual assessment. External protocol and live phase/slots are unverified; no efficacy or survival claim is inferred from the study rationale.
quotes: Other high-risk extracranial solid tumors: desmoplastic small round cell tumors, chordoma, malignant rhabdoid tumor, epithelioid sarcoma, myoepithelial tumor
Patients with progressive solid tumor disease after relapsed/refractory treatment.
Haplo-identical related donor (at least one full haplotype must be matched).

label: explicit_diagnosis_compatible
rationale: The Part 2 eligibility explicitly includes DSRCT and the detailed description assigns it to a separate stratum. Part 1 also permits broad relapsed/refractory biopsy-accessible solid tumors without standard therapy.
cohort_reconciliation: Part 2 follows dose determination in Part 1; its target accrual is driven by FLC but separate DSRCT/HCC/non-CNS MRT strata are stated. A common treatment arm does not erase this disease-specific enrollment route or establish the current part's availability.
extra_biomarker_requirement: No positive PD-L1 or other molecular threshold is required in the saved eligibility; these are exploratory measurements. Willingness to enroll on MAST and biopsy-accessible disease are explicit requirements.
protocol_uncertainty: Eligibility text requires age under 30 while metadata lists maximum 30; retain the stricter textual boundary pending protocol review. Unresectability, measurable/evaluable and safely biopsy-accessible disease, marrow-toxicity cohort rules and all other clinical constraints remain unassessed. External protocol and live strata are unverified.
quotes: Biopsy accessible refractory or recurrent (relapsed)or FL-HCC, DSRCT or non-CNS MRT.

Eligible patients with hepatocellular (HCC), desmoplastic small round cell tumor (DSRCT) or non-central nervous system (CNS) malignant rhabdoid tumors (MRT) will be enrolled on separate strata but target accrual will be determined by patients with FLC.
Willingness to enroll on the St. Jude Molecular Analysis of Solid Tumors (MAST) study.
